title: Const Correctness: Buffer Summation & ROM Lookup
description:
In embedded C, `const` before pointer data (`const uint8_t *buf`) guarantees that the function will not write to or corrupt the caller's buffer.

### Requirements:
1. `sum_bytes(const uint8_t *buf, uint16_t len)`: Read and accumulate bytes using index or pointer walk.
2. `lookup_crc(uint8_t index)`: Return lookup from `crc_table`.
hint: Whenever a function receives a buffer that is only read, always type it as `const uint8_t *`.
